WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as trans_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    trans_count,
    SUM(trans_count) OVER () as total_count,
    CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(trans_count) OVER () as share
  FROM grouped
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(share) as baseline_share
  FROM with_totals
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    wt.ordertypedist,
    wt.trans_count,
    wt.share,
    wt.share - b.baseline_share as above_baseline
  FROM with_totals wt
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE wt.share > b.baseline_share
)
SELECT
  ordertypedist,
  trans_count,
  share,
  above_baseline
FROM final
